name: Isosurface Color Enhancement
aliases: Color Enhancement via Scalar Changing Rate
definition: A technique to assign material color to an isosurface by approximating the accumulated alpha in a semi-transparent neighborhood behind the surface, using the scalar changing rate (directional derivative) as a proxy for neighborhood thickness.
summary: Isosurface Color Enhancement is a shading technique that reveals internal structures by approximating neighborhood density via scalar changing rate, maintaining standard rendering complexity.
